statements.quote: Name each capability for a cohesive system behavior that can own related requirements as the system evolves.

statements.notes: Capabilities must not be named after tasks or proposal sections
statements.quote: Do not name implementation tasks or proposal sections.

statements.notes: Kebab-case is checkable by regex; following existing organization is a judgment call
statements.quote: Use kebab-case for path segments you introduce (e.g., user-auth or identity/user-auth) that follow the project's existing spec organization.
statements.target: new capability path segments in proposal.md / specs/

statements.notes: Each modified capability must match an existing openspec/specs/<path> directory
statements.quote: Use the exact existing path under openspec/specs/.

statements.notes: Modified Capabilities may be empty when no existing requirements change
statements.quote: Leave empty if no requirement changes.

statements.notes: If proposal lists no new/modified capabilities, .openspec.yaml must contain skip_specs: true
statements.quote: A change with no capabilities at all (pure refactor, tooling, docs) must set `skip_specs: true` in its .openspec.yaml - openspec validate rejects a zero-delta change without that marker.

statements.notes: Fabricating requirements to pass validation is forbidden; use skip_specs instead
statements.quote: Do not invent a requirement just to satisfy validation.
